The client's plan to edit content in Canva does not change the required platform, access level, ownership, editability, or asset policy.

The source contains no decision about hyperlink behavior or functionality in the saved proposal.
The revised editing schedule does not change the final PDF format, file count, export quality, or email-submission requirements.
Although the client plans to update content, the source does not change the page-limit goal or prescribe a new page-reduction action.
The source does not identify any table replacement, formatting change, or revised table-integration instruction.
The source does not alter photo selection, placement, or graphic treatment.
The client announces ongoing Canva content edits but does not specify a change to narrative coverage, section order, or the unresolved Section 6 requirement.
The source does not change the Agua Arc identity or the brand assets to be applied.
The source does not mention or change the cover letter's one-page requirement.
